events.label: EU and UK diesel emergency stocks June 2026

slots.name: EU stock requirement
slots.sentence: EU rules require member states to maintain emergency oil stocks covering at least 90 days of net imports or 61 days of domestic consumption, whichever is greater.

slots.name: UK diesel supply share
slots.sentence: The UK, which has similar requirements for diesel emergency stocks, relies on the US for about 30 percent of its diesel and has a reserve of about 42 days.

slots.name: UK reserve duration
slots.sentence: has a reserve of about 42 days

slots.name: Germany emergency stocks
slots.sentence: Germany holds the largest amount of emergency stocks at 5.6 million tonnes, followed by France, which holds 8.2 million tonnes, according to Eurostat data.
